candidate.body: A firm maintains partners’ accounts under the fixed capital method. After all appropriations, a residual profit of ₹1,20,000 is to be shared equally between its two partners. Which journal entry records the transfer of this profit to the partners?
options: Debit Profit and Loss Appropriation Account ₹1,20,000; credit each partner’s Current Account ₹60,000.
